news.headline: WTI Crude Oil Slumps -2.44% to $80.35 on Iran-US Diplomatic Progress
news.what_happened: WTI crude fell sharply 2.44% to $80.35/bbl; Brent dropped 2.27% to $85.29/bbl as signs of diplomatic progress between Iran and the US eased oil supply disruption fears.
news.why_it_matters: A sharp crude fall directly reduces jet fuel costs for airlines, raw material costs for paint, tyre and chemical companies. India's import bill narrows, supporting the rupee and current account.

news.headline: US Markets Post Modest Gains — Dow +0.3%, Nasdaq +0.66% on Aug 25
news.what_happened: S&P 500 rose 0.32% to 7,677 and Nasdaq gained 0.66% to 26,151, supported by falling oil prices easing inflation fears and bond yields retreating.
news.why_it_matters: Positive US close provides a risk-on cue for Indian markets. FII flows likely to remain supportive. Banking and bluechip Nifty 50 stocks benefit from global risk appetite.

news.headline: Asia Risk-On: Hang Seng +0.95%, Nikkei +0.34%; Goldman Sees China Easing
news.what_happened: Hang Seng rose 0.95% and Nikkei gained 0.34%. Goldman Sachs expects Chinese monetary easing as GDP growth runs ~4%, below Beijing's 4.5-5% target.
news.why_it_matters: China easing expectations revive metal demand outlook. Asian strength provides broad positive cues for Indian equities and FII risk appetite.

news.headline: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Falls 6.5 bps to 4.639%
news.what_happened: US 10Y yield fell 6.5 basis points overnight as oil price decline eased inflation expectations and bonds rallied.
news.why_it_matters: Lower US yields reduce opportunity cost of EM investments, supporting FII flows into India. Positive for rate-sensitive domestic sectors — banks, NBFCs, real estate.

news.headline: FII Net Buyers ₹1,182 Cr; DII Also Buy ₹2,493 Cr — Dual Institutional Support
news.what_happened: Both FIIs and DIIs were net buyers in the Aug 24 session, reflecting continued institutional confidence in Indian equities.
news.why_it_matters: Dual institutional buying is a strong market support signal. Large-cap Nifty 50 stocks see broad sustained buying; supports index-level momentum.

news.headline: Natural Gas +1.31% — Headwind for Fertilizer Sector
news.why_it_matters: Fertilizer companies use natural gas as primary feedstock for ammonia/urea production. Rising gas prices compress margins for key players.
